en.disclaimer: Unspoken is an emotional education tool that helps you understand feelings and relationships. It is not counselling or therapy, and it cannot replace help from a professional. AI answers are based only on the courses and the materials you upload, and may not be fully accurate.
en.message:
What you just wrote makes us care about your safety. You don't have to carry this alone.

If you are thinking about hurting yourself, or someone is hurting you, please tell an adult you trust right away, such as a family member, a teacher or your school counsellor, or call one of the numbers below.

If you are in immediate danger, call 110 (police) or 120 (ambulance) now.
